title: Plugin dependency
description: Plugin-dependency inventory: call sites per plugin component (MBS and others) × file, resolved via calls_pluginfunction, plus Install Plug-In File steps. A risk view — which modules would be dead without the plugin?
author: fm-lab

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter (from the app-level filter).

params.name: component
params.description: Restricts the function list to a plugin component (e.g. Files, CURL, JSON). 'All' (or empty) lifts the filter.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows returned by the lists.
